title: Trump, Xi wrap state visit centered on spectacle over substance — trade truce extended 2 months
summary: Xi Jinping concluded a 3-day U.S. state visit. The two sides agreed to extend their existing trade truce by two months to January 10, 2027. No breakthrough on tariffs, rare-earth export controls, U.S. tech restrictions, or AI governance. Hang Seng fell 1% during Xi's visit, weighed by suspended southbound trading (Mid-Autumn holiday) and rising U.S. Treasury yields.
why: 中美贸易休战仅再延2个月至2027年1月10日，未达实质突破；关税、稀土、科技限制均维持现状，不确定性继续压制中概股与港股估值。短期sell put方向需谨慎，波动率仍偏高

title: China saw 'surprise' jump in U.S. orders ahead of Trump-Xi summit, private survey shows
summary: A private survey showed a surprise uptick in U.S.-bound Chinese orders ahead of the Washington summit, suggesting front-loading. Separately, official data showed China's exports to the U.S. fell 27% YoY in September, while global exports hit a 6-month high, rising 8.3%—indicating ongoing trade diversion.
why: 前置备货信号显示企业对贸易政策不确定性的对冲行为；中国出口持续向多元化转移，与持仓中出口敞口中国企业（拼多多Temu、阿里跨境）的营收预期有直接关联

title: Hong Kong Stocks Close (Sep 25) | Hang Seng Index Falls 1.01%; Low Trading Volume as Southbound Capital Absent; Lenovo Group Leads Blue-Chip Gains
summary: 恒生指数9月25日收跌1.01%，报24,510.09，为连续第三日下跌；H股指数跌1.21%，科技指数跌1.13%。小米、快手跌逾3%，阿里巴巴、百度、美团、京东跌逾2%。港股通因中秋假期在即暂停南向交易，流动性偏低，成交量清淡。
why: 港股科技板块全线下挫，腾讯、美团、小米等主要持仓均承压；南向资金缺席期间股价波动放大，做空信号不强但卖put的保护垫变薄

title: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
summary: The Fed Board proposed two regulatory frameworks on September 24: (1) requiring Board-supervised stablecoin issuers to fully back tokens with T-bills and high-quality liquid assets, plus capital standards; (2) a tailored application process for banks wishing to issue payment stablecoins. Circle (CRCL) meets all requirements from day one; Tether faces significant reserve restructuring. USDC surpassed Tether in on-chain transaction volume for the first time since 2019.
why: 持仓Circle(CRCL)直接受益：监管确定性大幅提升，GENIUS Act框架巩固USDC合规护城河；USDC交易量已超越Tether，Circle既是规则制定的受益者也是市场份额的赢家。对CRCL的long/sell put方向均偏正面

title: Stock market news for Sept. 25, 2026 — S&P 500 and Nasdaq notch weekly wins as markets shrug off bond sell-off
summary: U.S. equities closed higher on Friday: Dow +0.93% (51,828), S&P 500 +0.51% (7,743), Nasdaq +0.5% (27,068). Markets ended the week with gains despite a week-long Treasury bond sell-off. University of Michigan final consumer sentiment for September fell to a 4-month low on high gasoline prices and tariff concerns.
why: 美股周线收高但消费者信心下滑至4个月低，关税担忧是主因；标普500与纳指反弹为持仓美股标的（NVDA、TSLA、PLTR等）提供短期支撑，但债券收益率居高不下压制估值扩张

title: 阿里发布新一代AI芯片真武V900，2027Q1量产
summary: 阿里平头哥在2026云栖大会（9月22日）发布真武V900 AI芯片，算力为上代M890的3倍，支持216GB显存、1200GB/s片间互联、FP8/FP4精度；配套磐久超节点服务器2027年Q1量产。同时预告下一代真武J900计划2028年3月上市。
why: 延续报道：云栖大会9月22日发布，业界分析仍在持续。阿里自研AI芯片取得重大突破，降低对英伟达GPU依赖，强化阿里云在国内AI基础设施市场的竞争力，支撑BABA/9988长期估值逻辑

title: On September 25, Xiaomi Group-W (01810) repurchased 1.929 million shares at a cost of HK$50.0569 million
summary: 小米集团(01810)于9月25日回购192.9万股，耗资约5005.69万港元，继续执行回购计划。此前小米8月销售电动车30,153辆，连续5个月维持3万辆以上，截至9月7日累计交付超80万台。
why: 小米持续回购彰显管理层对当前估值的信心，对持仓方向正面；单日回购规模不大，期权策略无需调整
